text: HydroSOS‑BaNe integrates observations, models, forecasts, and service delivery to bridge the gap between hydrological observing systems and real-time decisions in water management. It includes continuous monitoring of hydrological variables, generation of standardized status products, and creation of short-range to seasonal outlooks. The project emphasizes tailored dissemination to decision-makers and capacity development for sustainable operations.

metadata.solution_name: Hydrological Status and Outlook System for Integrated Water Resources Management and Climate Resilience in Bangladesh and Nepal (HydroSOS‑BaNe)
